status: Exact theorem for normal Gaussian quotient; floating point numerical coefficient audit on two genuine Penrose ambient patches; NOT a nonlinear Haar concentration bound

results.gaussian_24_mode_tail: P(lambda*sH >= t) <= min(1,2^36 exp(-t/2)), uniformly in ambient volume, for exactly linearized free-boundary Gaussian measure, NOT SU2
results.linearized_Gaussian_theorem: For each independent SU(2) tangent color the full retained curvature is N(0,P_im(D)/lambda). All local-marginal covariance eigenvalues are <=1, independent of ambient size. For local A, P(lambda*s_H^lin >= t) <= min(1, 2^(3|A|/2)*exp(-t/2)); this is NOT a nonabelian SU2 theorem.
